name: p4-temportal
description: Keeps every file Claude Code would otherwise write under AppData or the system temp directory in <project>/.claude/p4/temportal/: the per-project memory in memory/ (AppData keeps a pointer MEMORY.md, and the session start prints the index the built-in would), the notebook in scratchpad/ with logs, build results and binaries swept into its ignored .out/, and each session's scratchpad as a link to tmp/<session>/, tracked by the p4 repo. Replaces p4-memory and p4-scratchpad, and moves a store they wrote flat in .claude/p4/ into each plugin's own directory.
